buyers_guide.q: Will a smart fan control work with my ceiling fan?
buyers_guide.a: Wall fan controls work with fans that are switched from the wall and have a pull chain left on high. If your fan uses a handheld remote and a receiver in the canopy, you need a receiver-based controller instead.

buyers_guide.q: Can it also control the fan's light?
buyers_guide.a: Some combo switches control both the fan and the light separately, which needs separate wires for the fan and light. Single-function controls only do the fan.

buyers_guide.q: Why not use a regular dimmer on a fan?
buyers_guide.a: Dimmers aren't designed for fan motors and can make them hum or overheat. Use a control rated for fans.
